---
title: Black Risotto with Cuttlefish
id: MAR-0107
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 65
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g cuttlefish, ready to cook, with their ink sacs
- 280 g rice
- 1 small onion
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 dl tomato sauce
- 9 dl fish stock
- 1 dl white wine
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 10 g butter
## Method
1. Cut the cuttlefish into large strips.
2. Heat the oil in a pan, add the peeled garlic and the peeled and diced onion, and let them wilt for 5 minutes.
3. Remove the garlic, add the cuttlefish and let them flavor for 3-4 minutes; raise the heat, pour in the wine and let it partially evaporate.
4. Then adjust the heat, add the tomato sauce, stir, let cook for 30 minutes, dissolve the cuttlefish ink in the cooking juices and cook for another 10 minutes, moistening with a little hot broth.
5. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for one minute.
6. Add the boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
7. Add the cuttlefish, stir, and serve.
8. Black Risotto with Cuttlefish
